title: Radioactive End - Datapack
description: Radioactive End is required this datapack to function properly.
body:
**[Radioactive End texture pack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/radioactive-end) requires this datapack.**

---

## What does this datapack do?
- End city's glass color turn from magenta to lime.
- End flash ambient color turn from purple to green(Only for versions 25w45a and above for now.)
- End city's magenta flama turn to lime.
